active_gate.purpose: Audit the typed GUI defaults across complete 80-iteration cold and corrected profiled trajectories.

runtime.reason: Cold and warm wall observations conflict, the warm retry is cross-GPU, and neither complete pair retains the same hard-state trajectory. No speedup or regression claim is valid.

active_gate.current_action: Keep the typed defaults, isolate the first active-particle envelope escape at iteration 37, and withhold any runtime claim until a same-GPU trajectory-matched pair exists.

short_gate.comparison_note: 177 s is below the 182 s accepted short baseline but above the 169.40 s prior exact-control result; these are cross-run H100 observations, not a paired speed result.

profile_toggle.reason: Both crossed pairs favor profiler-off, but late arms slowed together because pass-1 and raw-cache work contended with an overlapping workload on the node. Direction is accepted; the 1.0627x median magnitude is not a production speed claim.

between_pass_raw_cache.reason: The isolated two-pass slice is exact and faster, but its absolute saving is noise-scale end to end; pass 1 and cached pass-2 preprocessing become slower, and the first clean full pair regressed by 1.45%.

shared_coarse_projection_cache.reason: The shared primitive is exact, but it is slower below about 45 images and only 1.1% faster at batch 200. GF46 has one image batch per pass, so it cannot amortize cache construction across batches and the loose end-to-end ceiling is below 0.52%.

decisions.evidence: Coarse scoring, compact planning/fine posterior, Wavg, radix buckets, and ordered accumulation already use the mature EM implementations.
Job 13203664 was quality-neutral (80/80 particles; 81/81 maps) and reduced wall 293->291 s.
Exact-control wall regressed 169.40->172.20 s (+1.7%); 9cb34ddf2 was reverted by 274e4062d.
Job 13249200 was bitwise exact but 2--4x slower because it repeated projections.
788,541/802,681 coarse scans changed; commit 31953d remains a regression-only prototype.

decisions.status: KEEP; POLICY + MAP PASS; PARTICLE OPEN
decisions.evidence: Audit job 13256248 confirms typed policy PASS 80/80 in both arms and the same-GPU map envelope PASS 81/81; the active-particle envelope first fails at iteration 37, so correctness remains open.
Job 13254010 failed closed after the sealed candidate cache changed; its completed warm arm was slower (+4.1% wall and +7.3% pass 1).

The 23.91x active-3 microgate was superseded by full paired job 13257087: only ~0.69% median wall gain on a forced nondefault native-texture path, 120/120 strict artifact mismatches, and no production-kernel benefit.

Same-GPU crossed job 13258895 favored profiler-off in both pairs (+14.37% and +0.95% cost when on) with exact 20/20 pose/translation trajectories. Shared node contention invalidates a precise magnitude claim.

decisions.candidate: bounded pass-1 to pass-2 raw cache
decisions.evidence: Job 13260861 is bitwise exact in 15/15 sampled blocks and saves ~0.061 s per 200-row two-pass slice, only ~4.9 s over 80 iterations; the first clean full pair was 1.45% slower.
Jobs 13261042/13261159 are bitwise exact; job 13261339 crosses over near batch 45 and reaches only 1.01115x at batch 200. GF46 has one batch per pass, so its end-to-end ceiling is below 0.52%.

speed_snapshot.current_summary: Typed cold was +9.3% on the same GPU while the corrected warm retry was -1.9% on a different GPU; trajectories differ, so neither a speedup nor a regression is established.
